edits.before: Q-poke and AA-trade — your base stats are quietly elite. Identify how Lillia contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Q-poke and AA-trade — your base stats are quietly elite, and Lillia cannot kill either. A wash while you both farm levels.

edits.before: W brittle turns every trade into bonus %HP damage. Only take the trade when Lillia's Blooming Blows is down.
edits.after: Blooming Blows is 6s and its edge deals true damage — your armour does nothing and you cannot trade back yet.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Lillia must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Even with Q and W up she never stands still — Blooming Blows stacks move speed on every hit, so she kites out of Brittle range.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Blooming Blows's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your E-Q pillar knock-up is the only engage you have, and she sees the telegraph coming. Bank CS instead of whiffing a 14s E.

edits.before: Call of the Forge God re-engages a whole fight — and your forge prints item leads. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Lillia's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Lilting Lullaby is 150s at 1600 range, but it only sleeps targets carrying Dream Dust — if she has not hit you with a spell, R does nothing.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Blooming Blows's cooldown.
edits.after: Your tank item survives her DOT but does not catch her — Blooming Blows outruns you every trade.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Lillia carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Lillia carry threat 8/10: you cannot itemize into catching her. Play the fight your team is in, not the side lane.

edits.before: Weather the poke — brittle-proc him on the Blooming Blows cooldown and out-item the lane. Ornn wins the Blooming Blows cooldown windows.
edits.after: Weather the DOT — Brittle her the moment her speed stacks drop, and out-item the lane. Ornn wins only where terrain traps her.

edits.before: Brittle-proc him on the Blooming Blows cooldown and out-item the lane. Track Blooming Blows before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Brittle her when her speed stacks drop and out-item the lane. Trap her against terrain before you commit and keep the wave on your side.

edits.before: Q the pillar behind Lillia, E-dash through it for the knockup when his answer is down, and W-brittle the trade for the proc.
edits.after: Q the pillar behind Lillia, E into it for the knockup, then W-Brittle — commit only when Blooming Blows' speed stacks are gone.

edits.before: E-dashing with no terrain in the line — no knockup means you delivered yourself to his combo for free.
edits.after: E at open ground — with no terrain there is no knockup, and she just walks away with her speed stacks.

edits.before: Her kite + move speed stacks. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Every spell hit stacks her move speed — engage when the stacks drop.

edits.before: That is Lillia's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Its outer edge deals true damage, so armour reads that trade wrong — stay out.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: A 14s E spent on open ground leaves you naked and still not on her.

edits.before: E-dashing with no terrain in the line — no knockup means you delivered yourself to his combo for free.
edits.after: Lilting Lullaby only sleeps you if you are carrying Dream Dust — disengage after her first hit lands.

edits.before: - Lillia Blooming Blows: matchup-defining — Her kite + move speed stacks. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Lillia Blooming Blows: matchup-defining — 6s at rank 1, true damage on the outer edge, and every hit stacks her move speed. - Lilting Lullaby: 150s, and it only sleeps targets already carrying Dream Dust.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Blooming Blows: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If behind, farm safe and let your spikes re-open the lane.
edits.after: Trade only when Blooming Blows' speed stacks are down: with them up she leaves before Brittle procs. Stacking armour is wrong — her Q edge is true damage.

notes: Tension a human should settle: every level row now reads Lillia, yet Ornn's recorded win rate here is 51.14% over 1228 games and the page's diff enum says EVEN. Both can be true (she wins stages, he wins games), but if the site treats an all-enemy chart as implying UNFAV the enum needs a decision. I did not restate the page's 'unstoppable / shield' claim for Bellows Breath — Riot's text does not support it. I also considered noting that Swirlseed rolls until it hits a wall, so a magma pillar could stop it short, but the kit does not confirm a pillar counts as a wall for that check, so I left it out.
